SparkR / SPARKR-140
Pipelining causes error on simple transformation
Issue Type: Bug
Assignee: Unassigned
Components: Internals
Created: 17/Nov/14 1:09 PM
Priority: Major
Reporter: Zongheng Yang

Minimal example:

rdd <- textFile(sc, "./README.md")
lengths <- lapply(rdd, function(x) { length(x) })
take(lengths, 5) # works
lengths10 <- lapply(lengths, function(x) { x + 10})
take(lengths10, 2) # breaks

This is likely related to this line, changing which to FALSE seems to eliminate the issue.

One workaround is to cache the `lengths` RDD first.

We should figure out what exactly the issue is & perhaps in the mean time add some more doc in the code on how pipelining works (e.g. state invariants on some key variables).
